{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
non_qa_sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
loyal_completed = non_qa_sales[(non_qa_sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (non_qa_sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Calculate mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Output
print(f"Number of loyal completed orders (after removing QA): {len(loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Mean revenue (after removing QA): {mean_revenue}")"}
